Nutrition: 
C: 39 | F: 21 | P: 4
Calories: 359 per serving 
Makes 10

Ingredients
140 g butter, i used salted but if using unsalted, add 1/4 tsp salt to the dough while you add flour 
100 g brown sugar
50 g caster sugar
1 egg
1 tsp vanilla extract
150 g maida+  1/4 tsp baking powder + 1/4 tsp baking soda
220-250 g chocolate, mix of dark and milk ( choose your own blend )
sea salt for topping

Method
melt the butter in a saucepan till it starts browning, you can let it bubble etc but once it starts browning, ensure you stir for even browning and then leave to cook for 15-20 minutes
( post browning, there is moisture loss so you need 100 grams of butter total of the brown butter ) 
in a bowl, add the brown butter + brown sugar + caster sugar and mix together
add in vanilla + egg and beat for a minute
sift in the flour +baking powder + baking soda and fold together to form the cookie dough 
add in the chopped chocolate to the dough and fold together 
roll into 10 balls ( each will be between 65-70 grams ) and place half on a baking tray 
preheat oven on 180 degrees 
bake for 10 - 15 mins
use a large cup or a ring mould to shape the cookies ( basically bring the sides together soo its the perfect shape ) 
leave to cook for 10 minutes then enjoy then store in an airtight container once fully cooled
